title: AutoRFP.ai Pricing in 2026: Plans, Real Costs, and What to Budget
summary: AutoRFP.ai pricing starts at $899/mo (Scale) and $1,299/mo (Accelerate), billed yearly. See plans, real per-project cost, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
AutoRFP.ai pricing starts at $899 per month for the Scale plan (24 projects per year) and $1,299 per month for Accelerate (50 projects per year), both billed annually.


Enterprise pricing is customized for higher project volumes. Plans are based on annual project volume rather than seats, and all plans include unlimited users. A project is defined as one RFP, RFI, RFQ, DDQ, tender, or security questionnaire, regardless of the number of requirements or supporting documents.


What decides your real spend is the project model and the terms around it. This guide breaks down each plan and what it includes, what a project works out to as your volume changes, the contract commitments, and the costs that sit outside the subscription line.


## **AutoRFP.ai pricing plans and tiers**


AutoRFP.ai sells two public plans, Scale and Accelerate, plus a custom Enterprise tier. The two public plans are identical in features and differ only on price and how many projects you can run in a year.


Plan Monthly price (paid yearly) Annual total Projects per year Best for


Scale $899 $10,788 24 Teams with lower, steady response volume


Accelerate $1,299 $15,588 50 Teams with higher or growing volume


Enterprise Custom Quote-based 50+ (scalable) High-volume bid teams; per-project rate falls as volume rises


Prices are shown as a monthly rate paid yearly, so the annual totals above are what you commit to. Enterprise covers more than 50 projects a year, and AutoRFP.ai states the per-project rate decreases as volume climbs past that point.


### **What every AutoRFP.ai plan includes**


Unlike tools that gate capabilities behind higher tiers, AutoRFP.ai puts the same feature set on every plan. Each one includes:


- Unlimited users, so writers, reviewers, and subject-matter experts can all be added without per-seat fees.
- All features with zero paid add-ons, so no core capability is locked behind an upgrade.
- Single sign-on through Google and Microsoft.
- ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 security and compliance.
- 18 or more integrations, plus unlimited AI drafting and unlimited stored content.
- Implementation, online training, and unlimited support.


Scale and Accelerate carry this exact set; the only differences are the price and the 24 versus 50 project allowance. Enterprise adds bespoke implementation and contract terms on top.


Fact to know


**According to[Gartner](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2022-07-12-gartner-finds-that-majority-of-technology-purchases-come-with-high-degree-of-regret) , 56% of companies regret their biggest technology purchase.** That regret often comes from locking in before checking the fit. AutoRFP.ai’s 12-month contract makes it worth slowing down, so compare the pricing model, the terms, and the alternatives before you sign.


## **How AutoRFP.ai's pricing model works**


AutoRFP.ai charges by project rather than by seat. A project is a single[RFP](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/what-is-an-rfp-and-key-components-of-an-effective-rfp) ,[DDQ](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/ddq-meaning) , tender, or security questionnaire, and it usually maps to one opportunity in your CRM. Your plan sets how many you can run in a year, and because users are unlimited, adding people to a project never changes the bill.


Because every feature ships on every plan, project volume is the only reason to move up a tier. You do not upgrade to unlock SSO, integrations, or AI; you upgrade because you need more projects. That makes one number the heart of the decision: how many RFPs and questionnaires your team will run in a year.


## **What AutoRFP.ai costs per project, and at volume**


Dividing each plan by its project allowance gives the effective cost per project: about $449 on Scale and about $312 on Accelerate at full use. Your real figure depends on how many projects you actually run, because the tier price is fixed whether or not you fill it.


Projects you run per year Plan needed Annual cost Effective cost per project


20 Scale $10,788 $539


24 Scale (at cap) $10,788 $449


50 Accelerate $15,588 $312


100 Enterprise (custom) Above $15,588 Quote-based


The more projects you run, the less each one costs, until you cross the limit and the price steps up to the next tier. If your volume is uneven or rising, plan for the higher tier up front, so a busy stretch doesn’t push you into an upgrade you didn’t budget for.


The takeaway is simple: a project plan only pays off when you fill it. Pick the tier that matches the volume you are sure of, not the volume you are hoping for.


### **How to calculate AutoRFP.ai’s payback and ROI**


The price tells you the cost. These two quick sums tell you the return. Payback is how fast the tool pays for itself.


***Payback in months = annual price ÷ monthly staff time saved.***


***Or skip the math and run it in our***[RFP ROI calculator](https://www.inventive.ai/roi-calculator) ***.***


**For example** , a team that runs 24 RFPs a year and saves 20 hours on each, at $50 an hour, saves $24,000 of staff time in a year, against the $10,788 Scale plan, which pays back in about five to six months. Use your own hours and hourly rate.


Cost per won deal puts the price next to the revenue it helps earn.


Cost per won deal = annual price ÷ deals won per year. At $10,788 and 12 wins, that is $899 a win, usually a tiny share of the contract it closed.


When your volume is hard to predict, a usage-based model takes that bet off the table, which is why more buyers now shortlist it.

A slow quarter costs you nothing extra; a busy one never forces an upgrade.***


## **Additional cost, contract terms, and commitments to check before you sign with AutoRFP**


The subscription is not the last word on cost. The commitments attached to it shape what you actually pay and how long you are locked in:


- **A 12-month minimum.** Contracts run at least 12 months after the first 30 days, so you commit a full year of budget and cannot scale down mid-term.
- **A conditional refund, not a free trial.** The 30-day money-back guarantee applies only if you complete set steps, which include importing three past responses, inviting two users, and exporting one project. Skip those and the refund does not apply.
- **Tier jumps, not top-ups.** Exceed your project allowance and you move to the next plan or to Enterprise, rather than paying a small per-project overage. Budget for the full step up.
- **Renewal pricing.** Your rate holds for the contract term and can change at renewal, so model a possible increase in year two rather than assuming today's price holds.
- **Paid yearly.** Prices are quoted monthly but billed annually, so the real commitment is twelve times the headline, due as a single annual bill.


## **AutoRFP.ai total cost of ownership: subscription, setup, and renewals**


‍


AutoRFP.ai’s public plans include implementation, training, and support, so there is no separate onboarding invoice to budget for. But the subscription is only part of the total cost. Your team also spends time preparing and migrating existing responses, mapping them into AutoRFP.ai, connecting integrations, and keeping the content library accurate over time.


That makes total cost easier to assess in three parts: **the annual subscription, the one-time effort to go live, and the recurring effort to maintain the system.** These internal costs do not appear on the quote, but they still affect your budget and should be included when comparing vendors.


Renewal increases matter, too. RFP contracts often run for a year or more, so a one-year price can hide the longer-term cost. For example:


Year What it costs (Scale example)


Year 1 $10,788 + your setup time


Year 2 $10,788 + a renewal increase


Year 3 $10,788 + a bigger renewal increase


A 7% annual increase would bring a $10,788 plan to about **$34,700 over three years** , before accounting for your team’s time. Ask for any renewal increase to be capped in writing so you can compare the full three-year cost.

## **Conclusion: Is AutoRFP.ai worth the cost?**


For small and mid-sized teams with steady, predictable volume, yes. Its real edge is transparency: most RFP tools hide pricing behind a sales call, while AutoRFP.ai publishes Scale and Accelerate openly and puts every feature on both plans. Its[4.8 out of 5 on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/autorfp-ai/reviews) from 61 reviews shows it works well for this group.


The trade-off is that AutoRFP.ai is priced for predictability, not growth. The value holds while your volume fits inside a tier. Once it climbs or swings, the project limits start costing you, and the 12-month contract locks the plan in until renewal. So the real question is not the price; it is whether you can forecast your volume a year out.


**Best fit if you:**


- Run a small or mid-sized proposal or sales team
- Have steady, predictable volume
- Want public pricing and fast setup


**Look further if you:**


- Expect volume to swing or scale fast
- Run well over 50 projects a year
- Would rather pay only for what you use


If that’s you, it’s worth scanning the[AutoRFP.ai alternatives](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/autorfp-alternatives) that pair better with changing volume.


Pro tip


Most RFP tools cost about the same, so price rarely decides the choice. What matters is how many more deals the tool helps you win. Faster, higher-quality responses can increase your win rate, and one extra win can outweigh the entire price difference.


For a team sending 50 bids a year at $100,000 each, a two-point lift in win rate means one additional deal worth $100,000—about 10× the annual fee. So weigh response quality and speed first, and price second.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Can I pay for AutoRFP.ai monthly?


Prices are shown as a monthly rate but billed yearly, so you commit to and pay the annual amount rather than month to month.


### Do the Scale and Accelerate plans include the same features?


Yes. The two public plans are identical on features, including unlimited users, SSO, integrations, and security. They differ only on price and whether you get 24 or 50 projects a year.


### What happens if I use up my project allowance?


You move up to the next plan, or to Enterprise, rather than buying single projects. Plan for the full tier jump if your volume runs close to the cap.


### Does AutoRFP.ai offer volume discounts?


On Enterprise, yes: AutoRFP.ai states the per-project rate decreases as annual volume rises above 50 projects. The two public plans are fixed.


### Does the price include onboarding and support?


Yes. The public plans include implementation, online training, and unlimited support. The cost that sits outside the quote is your team's time to migrate content and maintain the response library.


### Is there a free trial of AutoRFP.ai?


No standard free trial. AutoRFP.ai offers a 30-day money-back guarantee instead, which applies only if you complete its qualifying onboarding steps.


### How does AutoRFP.ai pricing compare with other RFP tools?


Most alternatives, including Loopio, Responsive, and AutogenAI, are quote-only. AutoRFP.ai is one of the few that publishes per-tier pricing, which the comparison above lays out.
